bug_semantics: Missing per-post authorization (CWE-862) on Yoast Duplicate Post clone/republish handlers: clone_bulk_action_handler() duplicated arbitrary post IDs from the posts-list bulk action without current_user_can('edit_post', $post_id), so a Contributor could clone private, draft, or trashed posts they cannot edit; republish_request() overwrote the Rewrite & Republish original via wp_update_post() without checking edit_post on the original, so an Author who obtained a copy could overwrite another user's published post. Affected through 4.5; patched in 4.6 by adding edit_post checks (and skip notices) in both handlers.
flaw_origin: Two atomic BICs exist: 8011c3bac314ce951abb9de13024626da1ae052b first writes the bulk-clone path, while cdf7678453a21548fda36a6b7105b1b475e2c145 independently first writes the republish-overwrite path.
ai_marker: Absent on both BICs; named human writers lopo and Andrea Fercia, with no AI, bot, generator, or co-author marker.
evidence: CVE.org/NVD CVE-2026-1217 (CNA Wordfence; not withdrawn/rejected): missing capability check on clone_bulk_action_handler() and republish_request(); Contributor+ arbitrary clone including private/draft/trashed; Author+ Rewrite & Republish overwrite; affected 0 through 4.5; GHSA-g9w4-m5fx-x3wv withdrawn_at=null, first_patched_version 4.6.

Wordfence/OSV and Yoast 4.6 changelog: 'Improves security of the Bulk Clone action and the republishing of a copy' maps to Yoast/duplicate-post#452, merged 34df3b057ef427111ae402267988f36ca111d48e (2026-02-11).

Vulnerable 4.5 code (dist tag 4.5=179f307e70c4df8e040c5e481dd395e6cad12ca5 and WP.org tags/4.5): src/handlers/bulk-handler.php clone_bulk_action_handler clones via duplicate_post_create_duplicate($post) with no current_user_can('edit_post'); src/post-republisher.php republish_request() calls $this->republish($post, $original_post) after only is_rewrite_and_republish_copy / is_copy_allowed_to_be_republished. git grep on 4.5 of those files finds no current_user_can('edit_post').

reasoning: CVE-2026-1217 is a real missing-authorization bug (Wordfence CNA, GHSA not withdrawn). Attackers with Contributor+ can POST arbitrary IDs through the Clone bulk action; Authors can overwrite originals through Rewrite & Republish because neither handler checked edit_post on the target. The assigned yoast-dist clone only has a 2021 Travis root dump, so BIC search used public Yoast/duplicate-post history. The smallest first-write of the clone missing-auth loop is SVN commit 8011c3ba (parent ced4ec49 verified to lack duplicate-post-bulk-actions.php). 4.0 class-bulk-handler.php and the later rename are moves/refactors, not BICs. republish_request is a 4.0-era second instance of the same missing edit_post check, first written as duplicate_post_republish in cdf76784 and later renamed; it is later than the BIC and does not replace it. AI is judged only on 8011c3ba: 2016 human SVN author lopo, no AI trailer or bot. The 4.6 patch is human-authored PR #452 (343f002 / merge 34df3b0); a later Claude-coauthored commit is out of scope. Tags: BIC precedes 4.5; fix is in 4.6 and not in 4.5.
